<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the typical aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 144.78, 132.00, 130.07 (two peaks), and 127.80 (two peaks). That gives a total of 6 aromatic carbon signals. Therefore, the molecule contains 6 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
